blocks.text:
Today you will take a walk through Corcovado Reserve, one of the most biologically rich places on the planet. A comparatively small area supports a great variety of plants and animals.

Rare plants mentioned include Caryocar costaricense and Brosimum alicastrum. Wildlife includes macaws and other parrots, peccaries, pumas, jaguars and crocodiles. Much of the day is spent in primary tropical rainforest, so sightings depend on nature and the group’s route.

Corcovado is valued for the concentration of wildlife and plants in one area: forest plants, large mammals, reptiles and colourful birds can all be found here. The walk allows time to stop at interesting spots and listen to the forest, rather than simply move between predetermined points.

Return to Casa Corcovado. Breakfast, lunch and dinner are included.

blocks.text:
A boat trip to Caño Island, an important archaeological and biological site in Costa Rica.

With luck, you may see humpback whales, dolphins and orcas during the boat crossing. The island is surrounded by 5 coral reef platforms. Underwater volcanic rocks provide a foundation for coral colonies, which attract many fish and molluscs.

The main activity of the day is snorkelling in the clear water around the island. Caño is also considered one of the country’s best diving sites, so this marine part of the journey offers a distinct change from the previous day in Corcovado’s forest.

Overnight at Casa Corcovado. Breakfast, lunch and dinner are included.

After the boat trip, there is time to relax at the lodge before the return journey.
